title: SkyrimNet Prompts - Local Models
tagline: Prompts for small local models - EXPERIMENTAL
description:
Prompt updates intended to optimize for small local models. Built on the cache-enabled prompts, so a local server's prompt cache reuses the system message and the history from one reply to the next.

This replaces the same files as Skyrimnet Prompts - Cache Enabled; use one or the other, not both. This cuts a significant amount of less important information from the prompt, and optimizes the presentation for the characteristics of local models, such as NVIDIA's upcoming Gemma-Nemotron 4B (Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B) model.

Recommended settings: temperature 0.7 for dialogue, reasoning off, and DRY sampling if your server supports it (dry_multiplier 0.8, dry_base 1.75, dry_allowed_length 2). Optionally if you have a lot of plugins that provide new actions: embedded actions off (actions are then chosen in their own call; replies come out faster and score a little better)
author: min
changelog: Initial, highly experimental release. Tuned on Gemma-Nemotron 4B (Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B) through SkyrimNet's new recursive prompt calibration framework.
